newsitem.title: LIBERIA: Gunmen kill nine in ambush on Liberia highway.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill nine in ambush on Liberia highway.

text.p: At least nine civilians were killed on Thursday when their commercial truck was ambushed by unidentified gunmen on a highway in western Liberia, peacekeeping officials said.
The attack on the dangerous Monrovia-Tubmanburg road appeared to be part of rampant banditry that forced international aid groups to pull out of the area last month.

Six people were killed a month ago in a similar attack on the highway. Most of the victims of Thursday's ambush were traders transporting goods from western Grand Cape Mount County to the capital Monrovia.

The incident blocked a scheduled inspection visit to the region by a European Union team of experts assessing the prospects of elections due to be held in Liberia by May under accords to end seven years of civil war.
West African peacekeepers are trying to disarm guerrillas under the plan and insist the election schedule will be kept.
